scripts.dev: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && concurrently -n learner,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @heirloom/learner" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && npm run build -w server && npm run export:web -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @heirloom/learner && npm run typecheck -w @heirloom/learner && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: biome lint && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-deps.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev:v0: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
